today_news.title: New benchmark ranks search APIs for AI agents on quality, cost, and speed
today_news.summary: Artificial Analysis has released the "Search Index," a benchmark that rates search API providers for AI agents on quality, cost, and speed. Of seven providers tested with GPT-5.6 Luna, Parallel, Exa, and Firecrawl scored highest.
